Print each participant sheet double-sided, one per person. Trainer packs hold separate keys and distribution cards. The [exercise brief](Module2_exercise_plan_v3.docx) specifies copies, cutting, posters and group allocations. All figures describe a fictional training case.

## Progress towards independent reading

Day 1 explicitly teaches mean, treatment effect, coefficient, p-value and confidence interval, then applies them to claims and comparisons. Day 2 questions the assumptions behind city comparisons. Day 3 separates cost-model assumptions from evidence, repairs charts and practises evaluator questions. Day 4 assesses five reading abilities independently, provides feedback and a targeted retry, then asks for a short defensible recommendation. This classroom check measures the taught abilities; it does not establish proficiency on all future reports.

[Day 1 activities and checks](day1_review.html) | [Day 2](day2_review.html) | [Day 3](day3_review.html) | [Day 4](day4_review.html)

## Interactive visuals and room voting

Native choices, evidence reveals, intervals, trend pictures, axis toggles and distributions require a prediction or source check. Fiona's claim cards, eight different score-rule cards, seven matching profiles, scenario wall and two-sheet credibility grid are retained. AI examples are authored source-checking drafts, with no external AI account required.

[Room voting download](GreenWaste_room_poll.zip) | [Classroom instructions](ROOM_POLL_README.md)

The course-owned tool provides anonymous Before/After votes, QR entry and totals hidden until voting closes. It runs on the facilitator's machine. Rehearse venue phone access; labelled cards remain the fallback. Open webR trainer decks early and rehearse the calculation on the teaching network; printed results provide a fallback.

The three downloads together include eleven decks, participant sheets, trainer packs, references, four poster files (five A1 sheets), the classroom brief and room tool. Unzip both deck downloads to the same folder. Browser R needs internet; the downloads do not bundle the external R runtime. The former Day 4 Session 3 and historical cases are excluded.

## Review status

All eleven decks were walked at presentation size with revealed feedback and relevant trainer output checked. Print pages were rendered and visually inspected. Screen and paper use shared computed objects. The full eleven-session print build was checked in an isolated copy. Local review links and published copy hashes are checked. The rebuilt week is published through the [working course hub](../index.html). The password gate remains in place. These review pages retain the build details.
